muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450

sven.desc: Sven travels with the Storm Hammer, becoming invulnerable during the dash. Applies a basic dispel on all enemies hit. Increases cast range. Alt-Cast deals additional 180 damage and increases projectile speed.

huskar.desc: Life Break now taunts the target upon cast, forcing them to attack Huskar. Increases cast range.

juggernaut.desc: Grants Juggernaut the Swiftslash ability — a quick 1-second Omnislash on a 20-second cooldown. Uses Omnislash's values. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

lifestealer.desc: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, disarming them and attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.

omniknight.desc: Guardian Angel now affects buildings and has a global effect on all allied heroes.

muerta.desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing 225 damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s — rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed by 30% and takes 20% more magic damage.

sven.desc: Warcry becomes undispellable and passively grants armor and movement speed to all allies near Sven. Additionally grants a physical damage barrier to all affected allied heroes upon cast. Increases effect radius and bonus movement speed.

huskar.desc: Lowers Inner Fire cooldown and causes it to apply a movement speed slow and heal Huskar for a percentage of the damage dealt to enemies.

juggernaut.desc: Increases movement speed during Blade Fury and attacks random nearby enemy units with reduced damage.

omniknight.desc: Omniknight is healed for 30% of the damage dealt by Hammer of Purity. Every 6 seconds, his next attack will fire a Hammer of Purity at the target.

sniper.desc: Grants Sniper the Concussive Grenade ability. Launches a grenade at the target area, knocking enemies back 475 units, dealing 200 damage, slowing them by 50% and disarming them for 3s. Also knocks Sniper back from the target area.
